headline: 5 Dividend Kings Continued to Pay and Raise Dividends Through Every Market Crash Since Black Monday
summary: Black Monday wiped out 22% of the market in a single day, and most investors never saw it coming. A small group of companies not only survived that crash and every major meltdown since, but kept sending bigger checks to shareholders each time the panic peaked.

headline: Return of the heartthrob: Why the men of the early aughts are booked and busy in advertising
summary: Nostalgia advertising remains all the rage, and brands are tapping Chad Michael Murray, Devon Sava, and other “nostalgia millennial talent” to revive the feeling of simpler times.
